_phase2_instructions.description: This file scaffolds Phase 2 automation. To enable:

orcid.step1: Get your ORCID ID from https://orcid.org
orcid.note: Public ORCID data can be fetched without an API key

crossref.step1: Add your email to config.sources.crossref.email (polite pool)
crossref.note: Crossref API is free and doesn't require authentication

github.step1: Add your GitHub username to config.sources.github.username
github.step2: Optionally add a personal access token for private repos
github.note: Token should be stored as an environment variable, not in this file

analytics.step1: Get analytics token from your provider
